turns.prompt: when I end a meeting, the recap leaves out any task that has a person on it but no deadline. like if they say 'Priya will send the contract' with no date it just isnt in the action items. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I've fixed it by changing the recap prompts; no code was actually filtering these tasks out. I haven't run a meeting to check the fix, so it's untested.

**What was wrong:** when a meeting ends, `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts` asks the model to write the recap, and nothing in the code drops dateless tasks afterward. The prompts were the problem. None of them said to keep a task with no deadline, and the only example given was a dated one ("Bob: Draft invite copy by Wednesday"). So the model learned that an action item needs a date and left out tasks like "Priya will send the contract."

**What I changed:** every end-of-meeting prompt now says to keep each task that has a person on it. If no deadline was mentioned, the task gets "(no date given)", and the model is told never to make up a date. For example: `Priya: Send the contract (no date given)`.
- `electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`: the shared rules (used both with and without a mode's custom sections) and the description of action items in the default recap.
- `electron/llm/prompts.ts`: the Groq version of the recap prompt, which now has a dateless example next to the dated one.
- `electron/llm/tinyPrompts.ts`: the recap prompt for small local models, and the team-meeting action-item format (`📋 [Who] to [What] by [When]`), which had the same gap.

To check it, end a short meeting where someone says something like "Priya will send the contract" without a date. It should now show up under action items.

**Separate issue, not changed:** the Groq prompt asks for a `summary` key, but `MeetingPersistence.ts` reads `overview`. So on Groq the recap's one-line overview probably comes out empty. I can fix that too if you want.

I found a likely second cause and patched it. I can't confirm it works: I can't run the app here, and TypeScript isn't installed in the project, so the changes haven't even been type-checked.

**What I think is happening:** when a mode is active (Team Meet, Sales, Recruiting, etc.), the end-of-meeting recap doesn't use the general action-items list my last fix changed. It fills that mode's own sections instead. Several of those sections are described as "All action items that were said **I** would do", which only covers your own tasks. So "Priya will send the contract" was likely dropped because it's Priya's task. The missing deadline probably wasn't the reason.

**What I changed:**
- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`:** when the recap prompt is built, any section that looks like an action-item section (titles containing "Action items", "Follow-up", "Next steps", "Tasks" and similar) now gets an added rule. It says to include every task with an owner, whether that's you or anyone else in the meeting, and to write "(no date given)" when there's no deadline. Your modes keep their own saved copy of these descriptions, so I added this rule at the point the prompt is built rather than relying on the template alone.
- **`electron/services/ModesManager.ts`:** the default Team Meet "Action Items" description now covers everyone's tasks, not just yours.

**Trade-off:** this also widens the Sales and Recruiting action sections, which were written to list only your own tasks. They'll now include other people's tasks too. I can limit the change to Team Meet and General if you'd prefer.

**To test:** end a meeting in the mode you normally use, where someone says something like "Priya will send the contract" with no date. If it's still missing, tell me which mode you were in and which AI provider you use (Groq, Gemini, a custom provider, etc.), since each of those uses a slightly different prompt.

I've stopped changing prompts, because the app you're testing can't be running the code I edited. This folder has never been installed or built: there's no `node_modules` and no `dist-electron/`. `package.json` starts the app from `dist-electron/electron/main.js`, which only gets created by a build. So whatever app you ran still has the old prompts, and neither of my fixes has been tried yet.

That also means I don't know whether my changes work. TypeScript isn't installed here, so they haven't been type-checked either.

**To try the fixes**, run this from this folder:

```
npm install
npm run app:dev
```

`app:dev` builds the Electron side and starts the app. If you normally use an installed copy of Natively or a different checkout, my edits aren't in it. In that case, tell me which folder you run from.

**If it still fails after a rebuild**, please send these three things and I'll find the actual cause:
1. **The terminal output after you end the meeting.** The app logs the model's raw reply as `[MeetingPersistence] Raw LLM summary response...` and which provider answered (`✅ Groq / Gemini / Custom provider summary generated`). That will show whether the model left the task out or something dropped it later.
2. **Which mode was active** (General, Team Meet, Sales, …).
3. **What you saw:** no Action Items section at all, a section missing only that task, or an item that's there but worded differently.

Unrelated, but you should know: `VARIANT.md` in this folder says it's a modified copy of the app made for an experiment. That's another sign this folder isn't the app you've been testing.
